snapshots.above_fold_structure: Left-aligned headline 'Break the code barrier' with subtext and blue CTA button, paired with right-aligned isometric product imagery stack.
Top navigation bar with logo and sign-in, followed by hero section with centered headline 'Make your website a growth engine' over full-width background imagery, with supporting subtext and blue CTA.

visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a balanced two-column hero layout with moderate proof density to a full-width, immersive hero experience with increased visual hierarchy, more prominent navigation, and significantly denser social proof through client logos and case study imagery throughout the page.
